description: TUW-GEOPHIRES is an interactive geothermal simulator for techno-economic analysis of geothermal fields used for direct heat, adapted from the GEOPHIRES v2 tool by K. Beckers and K. McCabe. It was published on Zenodo in March 2022 (version 0.1) by Mostafa Fallahnejad and Péter Ferenc Gyarmati and is suited to geothermal fields in Vienna. The package has three parts: GEOPHIRES-web, a web application; GEOPHIRES-api, which exposes the simulation as a REST API built with FastAPI; and GEOPHIRES-simulation, the simulator itself. The high-level interface and graphical front end target geothermal and energy experts and policy makers. Coverage is Vienna, Austria. The code is downloadable from Zenodo under the Apache 2.0 licence at no cost. Caveats: it is a single early release built on the legacy GEOPHIRES v2, and settings are tailored to Vienna. Simulation uses are screening deep geothermal heat supply for urban district heating. Related records: model-geophires-x is the current GEOPHIRES simulator, and data-geodh-geothermal-district-heating-europe-layers maps geothermal district heating potential.
